verdict.summary: The added sweep-level regression test reaches the real run_sweep terminal-reap path and isolates the load-bearing mutation boundary: all three cases begin with the same empty open-issue snapshot and lease, while only the direct per-issue response changes. Its assertions distinguish retention for a freshly confirmed open, non-terminal issue from release after a true absence or closed response, and they verify both the reported reap count and the exact released claim set. Capturing exceptions as values prevents a crash from masquerading as a successful detection. The accompanying rationale accurately describes the existing fresh-read confirmation flow. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-vacuity defect is evident. Round 2 is materially unchanged from the prior approved round, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
